subject: work/ll_v3/substrate/object_pose_track.py
contract_text: live pose/AABB from the scene, reports pose error and tracking gap

environment_fact.note: the 05_drill_lift scene's manipulated body reports name 'bottle'; treated as a scene fact, not a contract failure

pose_matches_probe.note: observe() reports 3-decimal rounded pos; difference < 0.001 m

reset_boundary_no_cross_episode_state.note: tracking_gap is None on the first call of each episode; no stale _object_track_last leaks across reset

live_motion_tracking_gap.method: perturbed the object safely with base_standoff_servo(standoff=0.15) then arm_pose_ik targets placed into it; no direct object-command tool was used

field_coverage.pose_error: present and correct (None when no target supplied; numeric otherwise)
field_coverage.tracking_gap: present and correct (None on first call of an episode, 0.0 static, true displacement under motion)
field_coverage.binding_constraint: null on success; 'pose_error' on far-target failure

verdict_rationale: All contract clauses are honored against live probe ground truth: live pose/AABB are truthful to <0.001 m, pose_error is numerically correct and gates at tol with binding_constraint='pose_error', and tracking_gap is None at an episode start, 0.0 when static, and equals the measured object displacement (0.03367491648096543 m) after a real perturbation. The primitive is read-only (L1) and never commands the object or lower body. No binding constraint applies.
